CustomField.description: DESIGNED, NOT SPECIFIED. Snapshot of Days Past Due at the moment the escalation level was last raised. Without it, a monotone level can never re-arm: if Yardi later CORRECTS the aging downward and it climbs again, the level is already at its high-water mark and the alert never re-fires. That is not hypothetical here - a billing correction, which is the FSD 5.9.5 Correct path, is exactly that scenario.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The days-past-due figure the current escalation level was calculated from. Lets escalation re-arm if Yardi corrects the aging.
CustomField.label: Escalation Basis Days
